observed_failure.interpretation: Memory changes predictions but does not recover held-out behavior. The learner uses family-level shortcuts instead of performing episode-level induction.

root_cause_hypothesis.claim: Fixed family mappings let the classifier minimize loss while ignoring the trace-to-label relation.
root_cause_hypothesis.counterfactual_test: Randomly invert all visible trace outputs and query labels for half of training programs. The hidden permutation is consistent inside an episode and unavailable outside its trace.

minimal_change.name: episode-consistent meta label permutation
minimal_change.reason: A query-only family shortcut becomes insufficient; successful prediction requires using the episode memory.

fair_ablation: compact semantic trace plus identical meta-label training

added_diagnostic_metrics.reason: Counterexample@10 has an approximately 1.0 random-success baseline on the current candidate domains and is retained but not treated as sufficient evidence.

decision: Run both raw-meta and compact-meta on seed 20260801. Continue other seeds only if at least one treatment exceeds chance on both held-out families without violating regression guardrails.
